# The Gastown Founder Crawl

Type: Pathway - a curated route through several venues
Stops in order: FriendsQuarters -> Launch Academy -> DCTRL -> Internet Archive Canada -> FUNK Coffee Bar

Five rooms, one afternoon: coworking, an incubator, the cypherpunk clubhouse, the national memory bank and the coffee bar where first meetings actually happen.

# FriendsQuarters
Type: Spaces & Places
Builder stage: ZERO → ONE, ONE → MVP
Location: 200–116 W Hastings St · Gastown
Fixed venue: yes - you can walk in
Coordinates: 49.2818562, -123.107943
Equipment and facilities on site: Recording & Podcast
Website: https://www.friendsquarters.com/
Directory rank: 3 of 46
Last verified: 2026-08
Vancouver's friendliest coworking, connection and media space — 5,500 sq ft with hot desks, a podcast room and an atrium, steps from Waterfront Station.

# The Strathcona Maker Mile

Type: Pathway - a curated route through several venues
Stops in order: Vancouver Hack Space -> Slice of Life -> MakerLabs -> Terminal City Glass Co-op -> The Arts Factory

The densest making corridor in BC — hack space to artist clubhouse to 26,000 sq ft of fabrication to a glass furnace to a warehouse of studios, all inside one square mile.
